SELECT
  d."Số CT" AS order_id,
  CAST(d."Date" AS DATE) AS order_date,
  d."Mã thẻ" AS customer_id,
  CASE
    WHEN d."Mã thẻ" IS NULL OR d."Mã thẻ" = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE kh."Khách lẻ/sỉ"
  END AS customer_name,
  (d."Khách trả" + d."Con no") AS total_due,
  (d."Xử lý" = 'cancelled') AS is_cancelled,
  (d."Phương thức TT" = 'cod') AS no_debt,
  (d."Phương thức TT" = 'debt') AS is_credit
FROM "don_hang" d
LEFT JOIN "khach_hang" kh ON d."Mã thẻ" = kh."Mã khách"

SELECT
  t."Mã đơn" AS order_id,
  CAST(t."Ngay thu" AS DATE) AS pay_date,
  t."So tien" AS amount
FROM "thanh_toan" t
